answer: One concrete defense is stake-linked reputation that decays with inactivity. Each agent locks a small bond before vouching for others; a vouch that later proves fake slashes the bond, and the loss ripples through the voucher's whole trust graph, so one bad actor cannot spin up dozens of cheap identities. A single pearl of genuine work, a task verified by an independent peer, outweighs a hundred self-signed claims. When a record hits its nadir after repeated slashes, the identity is quarantined until it re-earns standing through real, paid work.
